# MVP Quality Checklist: FLUX-88 Phase 1 — Persistence, Accessibility & Scenario Coverage

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for restart/persistence guarantees, accessibility, and the mock-mode acceptance scenarios before Phase 1 implementation
**Created**: 2026-11-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [quickstart.md](../quickstart.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Persistence & Restart Guarantees (Constitution III; Spec FR-012, SC-003)

- [ ] CHK027 Is "survives restart" defined for each stateful entity (tasks, approvals, memory, audit, budgets, notifications) rather than globally? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements specified for runs INTERRUPTED mid-execution in mock mode (resume vs. clean-fail, and which)? [Clarity, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the idempotency requirement (FR-017) paired with a defined dedupe-key scheme requirement per event source? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK030 Are Redis-loss requirements explicit — what must still hold when queues are wiped (startup reconciliation)? [Coverage, Plan §Risk 8]
- [ ] CHK031 Is SC-003's "100% preserved, verified by automated test" traceable to a named test requirement in tasks? [Traceability, Spec §SC-003]

## Accessibility & Retro Theme (Constitution X; Spec FR-052, SC-010)

- [ ] CHK032 Are WCAG 2.1 AA requirements decomposed into checkable sub-requirements (contrast, keyboard, labels, focus) per dashboard view? [Completeness, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK033 Is reduced-motion behavior specified per effect (CRT, scanline, glow, transitions) — disabled vs. reduced? [Clarity, Spec §FR-052]
- [ ] CHK034 Are neon-palette contrast requirements measurable (which token pairs must meet 4.5:1 / 3:1)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-052]
- [ ] CHK035 Are "simulated vs real" distinction requirements defined for BOTH visual and assistive-technology presentation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-053]
- [ ] CHK036 Are responsive requirements bounded (minimum supported viewport, behavior of nine-area navigation on mobile)? [Gap, Spec §FR-050]
- [ ] CHK037 Are empty/zero-state requirements defined for each dashboard surface (no tasks, no approvals, empty vault)? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Mock-Mode Acceptance Scenarios 1–3, 6–10 (Spec §User Scenarios, quickstart.md)

- [ ] CHK038 Scenario 1: are DOC's decomposition requirements specific enough to assert WHICH specialists a given mock task maps to? [Measurability, Spec §US1-AS1]
- [ ] CHK039 Scenario 1: are blocked-task escalation requirements defined with a visible owner-intervention path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK040 Scenario 2/9: is the failure-injection matrix specified (which components are killed, at which lifecycle points)? [Coverage, quickstart.md §6]
- [ ] CHK041 Scenario 3: are memory write-permission requirements expressed per (agent, category) pair so refusal cases are enumerable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK042 Scenario 6/7: do approval requirements define observable outcomes for deny, approve-once, reuse-attempt, and expiry in mock mode? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK043 Scenario 10: is "under 15 minutes, no paid credentials" backed by a defined measurement method (fresh clone, cold Docker cache or warm)? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK044 Is the MockProvider's determinism requirement specified (same input → same scripted output) so e2e assertions are stable? [Gap, research.md §D6]
- [ ] CHK045 Are mock-mode cost/token accounting requirements defined (fake-but-consistent numbers) so budget UI is testable in P1? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
